items.html: *Now, at first it was so in AK: the first three in him, which are AB — Keter, and SAG — Hochma and Bina; and this SAG, from its half downward, which are the Nekudot in it, was clothed from the Tabur of AK downward, inside MA and BON of AK. And all this is the internality of AK — self, lights, and vessels.
